//headers: space/Caddyfile sets these for the HF Space origin; this is the same set for the Vercel origin, which had none. frame-ancestors is 'self' (not 'none') so the app stays embeddable by its own pages — unlike the Space, Vercel is not framed by huggingface.co, but 'self' costs nothing and keeps the two origins' policies comparable. The enforced policy has no script-src. A full resource policy ships as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only only: violations show in the browser console (there is no report-uri endpoint), nothing is blocked, and it stays report-only until watched through a real LiveKit interview. Its script-src carries the sha256 of the inline pre-paint theme script in index.html; src/__tests__/cspHash.test.ts fails if that script and this hash (or the one in space/Caddyfile) drift apart. 'wasm-unsafe-eval' is for the self-hosted MediaPipe wasm; style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' for React style props; https: and wss: in connect-src stand in for deploy-time hosts (API origins, LiveKit) and are to be narrowed after the report-only output is reviewed. Keep this value identical in substance to space/Caddyfile.
